description: List SmartTests a human reviewer checked and flagged as NOT properly covering a scenario (testId, testName, filePath, scenarioId / scenarioOrdinalId / scenarioTitle, verificationNote with what is wrong, reviewedByUserId, reviewedAtMillis, latestJobId). Optional userId narrows to tests authored for that user (defaults to the OAuth token's user); optional limit. Read the note, fix the test, then call mark-tests-for-review so the flag resets and the test returns to human review.
name: list-tests-with-verification-issues
title: List Tests With Verification Issues
